exposure: Placental strain ratio values (measured by real-time sonoelastography)
Maternal subcutaneous adipose tissue thickness (measured by two-dimensional ultrasonography)
cohort: The study included 210 consecutive singleton pregnant women who applied for routine first-trimester screening between the 11th and 14th week of gestation.
finding: First-trimester subcutaneous adipose tissue thickness (>11.5 mm) and placental strain ratio (>0.986) were identified as independent risk factors capable of predicting the development of gestational diabetes mellitus.
gest_age: Observations were made between the 11th and 14th weeks, and the outcome was assessed between the 24th and 28th weeks of gestation.
